model.name: FeatureManager.revokeFeature
model.description: revokeFeature(featureName, token): HARDCODED-owner-gated write (root-of-trust). Removes token from Feature.allowedUsers AND mirror-maintains profile.features (both sides). Gated by ServerManagerGuard.assertOwner. INV-F4: non-owner revoke -> 403, never mutates. Flips the grantee's access back to non-member-403. LOAD-BEARING marked decl. Architect design 83836631a.
